crossRefs.note: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunder storm,
lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh…
“I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on…
Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time, Yahweh who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the…
He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
